Last week saw a flurry of price cuts on a range of current Apple products, from 25% off the AirPods Pro 3 to a $120 discount on the brand-new AirPods Max 2 — but the deals aren't over yet. While those discounts are still live, Amazon just dropped the Apple AirTag 2 (2026) to its lowest price ever — now available for as low as $20 each.

We featured a few all-time low prices on the AirTag 2 in our anniversary sale coverage last week, but if you missed those, don't worry — the price has now dropped even further, making this the best deal we've tracked.

Amazon still has the single-pack AirTag 2 for $24 — matching the best price we've seen since launch — but the 4-pack has dropped to $79.99 with free shipping.

Apple's official 4-pack is priced at $99, which is already a better value than the usual $29 per single unit; this nearly 20% discount sets a new all-time low, working out to about $20 per AirTag 2.

The previous deal of $90 for the 4-pack was expected to last through the week alongside major anniversary sales at other retailers, but Amazon's new all-time low is a different story — there's no telling when the price could suddenly jump back up.

We've previously covered the differences between the original AirTag and this year's AirTag 2 refresh — you can check out that piece here — but here's a quick recap:

  • Precision Finding range extended up to 1.5x further
  • Built-in speaker is up to 50% louder
  • AirTag 2 can be heard from up to 2x further away
  • Features "an industry-first set of anti-stalking safeguards"

New AirTag 2 features on the way

The AirTag 2 drop to $20 each comes just ahead of next month's reveal of iOS 27 and watchOS 27. For Apple Watch users, there's a particularly welcome upgrade: the Find My app is gaining support for Precision Finding. That means you can now use your Apple Watch with on-screen arrows and specific distance information to locate an AirTag.

watchOS 27 also unifies the Find My experience into a single app. Previously on Apple Watch, Find My was split into three separate app icons — People, Items, and Devices — within the app list or home screen.

Meanwhile, iOS 27 brings a fresh design and interface changes to the Find My app, making it easier to track people and items.

With all that in mind, now is a great time to expand your AirTag 2 collection — especially at this price.

More Apple deals this week:

  • AirPods Max 2 — $429 (was $549)
  • AirPods Pro 3 — $190 (was $249)
  • AirPods 4 — $99 (was $129)
